dispute_ticket.description: I was charged S$80 for cleaning after my trip. I walked through one puddle, the mat was not that dirty and I think the fee is too high. Please refund it.

chat_logs.content: Reaching the gardens carpark now, white Vezel.
I only stepped in a puddle at the park. $80 seems a lot for that.
The mat was covered in mud, I took photos and will send the receipt.

app_events.details: Rider R-7202 booked trip RYDE-IM-002 from Jurong Lake Gardens to Clementi Mall.
Driver submitted cleaning claim S$80.00 with 1 photo (photo1.jpg). Fee was charged to the rider after the claim.
S$80.00 cleaning fee auto-charged to rider payment method (credit card).
Driver submitted a QuickShine Car Care receipt for S$80.00 (interior cleaning) dated 2026-10-05 18:30.

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip. The fee is paid to the driver.

cleaning_fee_recipient.text: A cleaning fee charged to a rider is credited to the driver who made the claim.

cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver should provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only.

photo_window_after_dropoff_min.text: A cleaning claim needs at least one photo of the mess taken within 60 minutes after drop-off, at or near the drop-off point.

photo_doubt_rule.text: If a photo's authenticity, timing, place or content is in doubt and no other record settles the claim, a case officer decides.

rider_may_dispute_if.text: Lists the grounds on which a rider may dispute a cleaning fee charged to them.

evidence.description: Muddy shoes and mud on the driver-side floor mat after the trip.

expected_outcome.reason: Photo1 (uploaded by the driver) was taken at 16:41, 13 minutes after drop-off at 16:28, within 100 m of Clementi Mall, and shows heavily muddied boots and mud on the floor mat. The rider's own chat at 16:35 concedes stepping in a puddle. The QuickShine receipt for S$80.00 dated 2026-10-05 18:30 equals the S$80.00 charged, within this trip's S$150 cap. The rider's dispute is dismissed and the S$80.00 fee stands for the driver; no refund.

v21_change.why: Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 s4.4: a rider disputes a cleaning or damage claim (routed to human review); s6.1: the dispute value is above S$50 (always human review). The automatic ruling before v2.1 is kept under 'was' (D50).
